Results in invalid SSL certificates in Chrome, such as self-signed ones, being ignored.

## CLI flag

Use `--ignore-certificate-errors` with the following commands. Follow a command link for its syntax and examples.

| Command                                                         | Flag                          |
| --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
| [`remotion studio`](/docs/cli/studio)                           | `--ignore-certificate-errors` |
| [`remotion render`](/docs/cli/render)                           | `--ignore-certificate-errors` |
| [`remotion still`](/docs/cli/still)                             | `--ignore-certificate-errors` |
| [`remotion compositions`](/docs/cli/compositions)               | `--ignore-certificate-errors` |
| [`remotion benchmark`](/docs/cli/benchmark)                     | `--ignore-certificate-errors` |
| [`remotion gpu`](/docs/cli/gpu)                                 | `--ignore-certificate-errors` |
| [`remotion lambda render`](/docs/lambda/cli/render)             | `--ignore-certificate-errors` |
| [`remotion lambda still`](/docs/lambda/cli/still)               | `--ignore-certificate-errors` |
| [`remotion lambda compositions`](/docs/lambda/cli/compositions) | `--ignore-certificate-errors` |
| [`remotion cloudrun render`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/render)         | `--ignore-certificate-errors` |
| [`remotion cloudrun still`](/docs/cloudrun/cli/still)           | `--ignore-certificate-errors` |

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`renderMediaOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/rendermediaoncloudrun#ignorecertificateerrors)
- [`renderStillOnCloudrun()`](/docs/cloudrun/renderstilloncloudrun#ignorecertificateerrors)
- [`getCompositionsOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/getcompositionsonlambda#ignorecertificateerrors)
- [`renderMediaOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/rendermediaonlambda#ignorecertificateerrors)
- [`renderStillOnLambda()`](/docs/lambda/renderstillonlambda#ignorecertificateerrors)
- [`renderFrames()`](/docs/renderer/render-frames#ignorecertificateerrors)
- [`renderMedia()`](/docs/renderer/render-media#ignorecertificateerrors)
- [`renderStill()`](/docs/renderer/render-still#ignorecertificateerrors)

## Config file

```tsx twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';

// ---cut---

Config.setChromiumIgnoreCertificateErrors(true);
```
